description: This PHP class provides mathematical functions related to logarithms, such as computing logarithms with an arbitrary base, base-10 logarithm, and natural logarithm, with support for array inputs and validation.

classes.name: Logarithms
classes.description: A utility class for computing various logarithmic functions within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

methods.name: withBase
methods.description: Calculates the logarithm of a number with a specified base, defaulting to base 10.

methods.name: base10
methods.description: Calculates the base-10 logarithm of a number.

methods.name: natural
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm (base e) of a number.
